eraEvidence.targetEra: Publish 14.1 PRE-CU progression with retained expansion content
findings: Publish 14.1 XP grants name an authored XP pool and feed owned skill-box progression rather than a class-template level.
The retained TCG script already authored a random collection-item fallback for NGE level-cap players.
The three retained buff-backed instant-XP items route through tcg_xp_granted and the same authored random collection-item fallback in their inherited level-cap branch.
The seven retained tcg_xp_bonus items likewise author a random collection-item fallback for level-cap characters in xpBonusGeneralAddBuffHandler.
Using that authored content fallback for every PRE-CU player preserves all eleven items without inventing a generic XP pool or visible combat level.
